contracts: (IdentityBoundaryTests discovers and passes the authorized protected-entry-point case with nonzero count.) AND (IdentityBoundaryTests discovers both unauthorized cases with nonzero count and verifies unchanged policy state.) AND (The authenticated Snapshot selector is discovered and records a nonzero authenticated HTTP invocation.) AND (The explicit-request selector is discovered and verifies a persisted Snapshot attributable to that request.) AND (readback 仅在服务端 Account 授权通过时返回数据，越权请求必须拒绝。)
selector_intents: PhaseA.Platform.Tests.PhaseB.SnapshotTests.AuthorizedExplicitSnapshotCreatesSnapshot verifies one persisted Snapshot is created for an authorized explicit request.

PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests invokes the protected extension-policy administration selector with valid administrator credentials and fails if server-side authentication/authorization is absent or the authorized request is not accepted.
PhaseB.Repair.IdentityBoundaryTests submits unauthenticated and insufficient-role policy changes and fails if either receives success or policy state differs after the call.
PhaseB.Repair.OperationsBoundaryTests binds Snapshot invocation to the authenticated HTTP endpoint and fails on unauthenticated or bypass transport.
验证 readback 对未授权 Account 或跨 Account 数据请求返回拒绝且不泄露目标存在性。
